name: OSINT Framework
description: The classic tree of free OSINT tools by category. This hub's catalog started from it.

name: IntelTechniques Tools
description: Michael Bazzell's custom search tools and workflows for people, usernames, domains, vehicles and more.

name: OSINT.link
description: A large categorised bookmark directory of OSINT sites and resources.

name: Awesome OSINT
description: The biggest curated GitHub list of OSINT tools, bookmarks, APIs and tutorials, sorted by category.

name: Bellingcat Online Investigations Toolkit
description: Bellingcat's own directory of tools for investigative journalism, geolocation and image or map analysis.

name: Start.me
description: Public dashboards where researchers share thousands of OSINT links. Search for OSINT boards.

name: SpiderFoot
description: Automated OSINT engine: give it an IP, domain or email and it queries 100+ sources and graphs the result. Self-hosted.

name: Recon-ng
description: Python web reconnaissance framework with modules and API keys, driven from the command line.

name: Maltego
description: Visual link analysis: pivot between entities and see the relationship graph. Free community edition with limits.

name: WhatsMyName
description: Username enumeration data and scripts across hundreds of sites. This hub's username scan uses its list.

name: Maigret
description: Builds a profile dossier from a username by checking thousands of sites. Self-hosted.

name: SecurityTrails
description: Historical DNS records and subdomain mapping. This hub can query its API when SECURITYTRAILS_API_KEY is set.

name: subfinder (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Fast passive subdomain discovery from dozens of public sources. Written in Go.

name: httpx (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Probes a list of hosts for live web services and reports status, title, technology and more. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: naabu (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Fast SYN and CONNECT port scanner written in Go. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: nuclei (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Template-based vulnerability scanner with a large community template library. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: dnsx (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Fast DNS toolkit: resolve, query many record types and brute-force subdomains.

name: katana (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Next-generation web crawler for collecting endpoints and scripts. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: asnmap (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Maps organisations, domains and IPs to ASNs and CIDR ranges.

name: Chaos (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Dataset of subdomains for many public bug bounty programs.

name: OWASP Amass
description: OWASP flagship for attack surface mapping: public APIs, web archives, DNS and a graph database.

name: Masscan
description: Asynchronous TCP port scanner built for very large address ranges. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: Nmap
description: The standard network scanner: host discovery, ports, services, OS detection and scripts. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: RustScan
description: Fast port scanner that hands open ports to Nmap. Active scanner: use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

name: theHarvester
description: Gathers emails, subdomains, hosts and names from public sources.

name: Sublist3r
description: Python subdomain enumeration using search engines and public sources.

name: BBOT
description: Recursive, modular OSINT and recon scanner for attack surface discovery.
